excluded_behaviors: Launching VS Code and verifying editor extensions interactively
Installing Android, iOS, or browser toolchains reported by flutter doctor

headless_commands: if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then uv sync; fi
if [ -f CMakeLists.txt ]; then cmake -S . -B .clean-vm-build && cmake --build .clean-vm-build; fi
if [ -f CMakeLists.txt ]; then cmake -S . -B .clean-vm-build && cmake --build .clean-vm-build; fi
if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi
if [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then cargo build; fi
if [ -f go.mod ]; then go test ./...; fi
if find . -maxdepth 2 -name '*.csproj' -print -quit | grep -q .; then dotnet restore && dotnet build; fi
if [ -f Gemfile ]; then bundle install; fi

excluded_behaviors: Launching RStudio and changing graphical settings
Persistent server startup, root-password assignment, and interactive login
Launching MySQL Workbench and creating a graphical connection
